creator: Alexander Terp
description: MIP-10 stage 5: toward the CLI's reach (docs/mip/0010-api-for-other-tools.md section 2 and How it lands). The remaining `muster` verbs as API requests, window verbs (tabs, layout, focus, zoom) carried to an attached window, an observer connection for a pane's output that never sets its size and cannot displace the window's bridge, with taking control as a separate explicit request, and `agent.report` for harnesses without a Muster adapter. Each is a minor, in the order integrations ask for them; split this card when one is wanted.
title: MIP-10 stage 5: toward the CLI's reach
